description: Returns the probabilities for one football match from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet (not the Docteur Bet model, which is reserved for value bets in the app): home win / draw / away win, over/under 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 goals, both teams to score, expected goals, most likely exact scores and team strengths. Get the match_id from find_match or get_upcoming_matches. Always cite the source, the model and the calculation date.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

match_id.description: The match_id returned by find_match or get_upcoming_matches.

name: get_match_probabilities
title: Match probabilities
